notes.title: DBK Final Build Demo Update Out Now!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43686360/1899cd55644a8895f566e0e852bdd476d1d4042b.png

Hi all!

Hope you are all doing well. 

In conjunction with DBK's upcoming release, we have decided to update the demo accordingly as the final build of DBK has a lot more stuff added to it - even in the first chapter itself.

Here's a list of what comes with the whopping 900MB update:

1. Story cutscenes have been added to the game;
2. The demo now includes two chapters:
- Chapter 1 Bittersweet memories which takes place in the Old Water Village; and
- Chapter 2 Gaol of Stone which takes place in the Lost Woods.
This way you can experience more of the game before deciding if you'd like to purchase the full version.
3. The (rare) screen-freezing bug has been completely fixed!

We hope you enjoy this updated demo. Thank you for your support! We hope you check out the full game once it is released! =)

Sincerely,
Dennis Jar

notes.title: BMF Demo Update Out Now!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43686360/39298944976cc76b34d6a15aa00e041cc140e8e5.png

Hi all!

Hope you are all doing well. 

As promised to those of you who visited our booth at Brunei MSME Festival (BMF) 2023, we have uploaded the special BMF demo on here! Now you can experience the Dongeng Bayang Kulit demo with detailed parallax backgrounds by our artist Ryou in the comforts of your own homes!

Unfortunately we're having loading problems with linking this post to the latest demo build, so there won't be official patch notes. However we'll just spell it out here: 

1. The parallax environments for the Old Water Village and Strange Cave has been completely redone by our environmental artist Ryou;
2. We removed some minor bugs (namely the map not closing during tutorials, and the light bug NPC in the caves);
3. This special BMF demo also comes with additional abilities for both Captain N'man and Putri Matami! 

We hope you enjoy this demo. Thank you for the overwhelming support you have shown us at the event! We intend to do your kind words and encouragement justice! =)

Sincerely,
Dennis Jar
